text:
For you, for you, I cried out when you arose,

infernal archetype, from deep Erebus,

with your neutral charms, your ephebe face,

your pectoral breasts, and came to me.


Shadow and light, bud and pollen at once you were,

awakening in souls the new crime,

now with virilities of a young god,

now with wilted caresses of a sad woman.


I loved you because, in exchange for naive graces,

you had the supreme aristocracies:

blue blood, shy soul, infertile womb;


because you knew much and loved little,

and were rare synthesis of a mad century

and sickly flowering of an old world.

translation.title: For You, for You, I Cried Out When You Arose...
translation.editorial_note: This related version keeps the same androgyne portrait under its first-line title.
